- **#1299** (`react` 19.2.7→19.2.8 + `@types/react`): Dependabot bumped `react` and `@types/react` but left `react-dom` at 19.2.7, so React itself throws "Incompatible React versions" and every component test using `react-dom` fails (65 files).
